verdict.rationale: Unlike cloud-only accelerators, the H200 SXM ships in NVIDIA HGX partner and NVIDIA-Certified Systems with 4 or 8 GPUs that buyers can run in their own data centers. The CUDA Toolkit is documented for deploying applications in enterprise data centers, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise/NIM microservices support on-prem generative AI deployment. missing for 10: SXM-specific on-prem installation/operations documentation (the air-cooled enterprise rack and bundled AI Enterprise claims refer to the NVL variant), independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.
